item.name: Get Knowledge Hub Country Guides by Country Code

request.name: Get Knowledge Hub Country Guides by Country Code

description.content:
Retrieve country guide for different audience and contract type by the country code
 **Token scopes**: `knowledge-hub:read`

variable.description: (Required) Country code for which we need to fetch the country guides

response.name: Successful response containing audiences, their contract types, and associated categories, fields, and articles.

variable.description: (Required) Country code for which we need to fetch the country guides

header.description:
(Required) ## Authentication
The Deel API uses bearer tokens to authenticate requests. All API calls must be made over HTTPS — calls over plain HTTP or without authentication will fail.

```curl
curl -X GET 'https://api.letsdeel.com/rest/v2/contracts' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR-TOKEN-HERE'
```

[Learn more about authentication](/api/authentication)
